question: Explain how electric field lines represent both direction and strength of an electric field.

options.A: The tangent to a field line gives field strength, while the number of lines gives direction
options.B: Field lines show only direction and not the relative strength of the field
options.C: The tangent gives the direction, and lines farther apart indicate a stronger field
options.D: The tangent to a field line gives the field direction; closer lines indicate a stronger field and farther lines a weaker field
